title: Review of c18's flshell starved-daughter claim (IMED): gliders glide and divide on fresh seeds 7-8 (9 and 7 persistent splits, generation 5 and 4, 12-13 body lengths); the starve-one-daughter fork replicates on seed 8, while on seed 7 the two daughters re-merged right after the fork; Supported
summary: I looked at pack/seed0/sheet.png and forks/df3.png, then ran the claim's world.py with labkit on seeds 7 and 8 (t=800) and its scripts/dfork.py and dplot.py on seeds 7 and 8 (copied to my scratch). Pack: from one noise patch, crescent gliders spread and divide: 9 and 7 persistent splits, max generation 5 and 4, merge/split 0.85 and 0.69, 46 and 26 tracks moving >= 1 body length, up to 12.9 and 12.4 body lengths. Fork, seed 8 (t=245, pair 19 px, masses 106 and 50): in the cut run the starved daughter stops, shrinks and is gone by t~505, while its sister glides, grows to 323 and divides; in the fed twin the same daughter grows to ~180 and divides at t~490 (forks/df8.png; the tracker's drop to 0 at the end is that division). Seed 7 (t=255, pair 26.6 px) is not a test: the two bodies re-merged within ~50 t in both branches, so the tracker follows one merged body (forks/df7.png, df7.log). The claim's ratio (death 130-260 t after the cut) matches seed 8 (~260 t).

observations.M: rerun/seed7/FACTS.md: 46 tracks >= 1 body length, max 12.9; seed 8: 26, 12.4
observations.E: forks/df8.png: starved daughter gone by t~505 while the sister grows to 323 and divides; fed twin: same daughter grows to ~180 and divides
observations.D: rerun/seed7/FACTS.md: 9 persistent splits, generation 5; seed 8: 7, generation 4

seeds_run.result: pack pass; fork inconclusive (daughters re-merged after the fork)

controls_run.E: forks/df8.png: fed twin from the identical fork state, food cut following one daughter (the claim's dfork.py on my seed 8)

verdicts.limitation: One clean fork on a fresh seed (seed 8); on seed 7 the pair picked by dfork.py re-merged, so the fork-selection rule can pick daughters that are about to fuse. Merges are 69-85% of splits, so the genealogy is reticulate (confidence capped at medium). E is build-from-food by construction, as the claim says. Founders come from one planted noise patch, so S is not claimed.
